fieldValues.title: Routines review, report and allocate
fieldValues.body:
A **routine** is a cloud agent that runs a brief on a trigger. A **workflow** is a GitHub Action that runs clerk code with no AI. Together they keep the programme moving between sessions. ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph Allocate BS["board-sync"] RD["roadmap --apply"] AN["analyst
if the queue runs dry"] end subgraph Build BU["wg-builder"] UW["unattended worker"] end subgraph Review RV["wg-reviewer"] UP["pr-upkeep"] SC["steward --fix"] GD["ground (I1)"] end subgraph Report WS["wg-steward
cycle close"] DG["digest"] HW["handbook watcher"] end RD --> BS --> BU AN -->|files ready issues| BS BU --> RV --> UP UW --> UP UP --> WS SC --> WS GD --> WS WS -->|report on semanticops.com#31| OS([Owner session]) DG -->|semanticops.com#33| OS HW -->|handbook PR| OS ``` Exact schedules and triggers live in [tools.md](tools.md); this table says what each one is for. | Job | Runs | Kind | What it does | |---|---|---|---| | Allocate | `board-sync` hourly | workflow | rollup, topup, promote, stale claims, reconcile | | Allocate | `roadmap --apply` daily and on push | workflow | epic Priority from the period ranking, `parked` label | | Allocate | analyst, daily 12:00 | routine | only when the last report says "Queue running dry": files ruling-backed issues as ready | | Build | wg-builder, on events | routine | one group issue per run, claimed with `clerk claim` | | Build | unattended worker, nightly | routine | up to 3 `lane:unattended` issues, as the central group's builder | | Review | wg-reviewer, on PR events | routine | gates, mandate check, quorum comment; never reviews its own work | | Review | pr-upkeep, every 15 min | workflow | merges PRs whose gate label and quorum allow it; daily digest | | Review | steward check, daily | workflow | reopens false closes; comments on issues with no `Answers:` line | | Review | ground, daily | workflow | I1: share of merged PRs grounded to an affirmed problem | | Report | wg-steward, daily 11:30 | routine | closes the cycle: run report record, ratifies the group's decisions in one group session, report on #31 | | Report | handbook watcher, weekly | routine | re-reads code, data and boards; updates the handbook records; renders; opens a PR | **The desk.** Everything that needs the owner is on one pinned issue, semanticops.com#35 (label `desk`). `clerk desk --post` rewrites its body in place, never as a comment, in three parts: **Needs you** (unreceived reports first when a group is paused, decisions to ratify, open exercises, owner merges with their `Decision asked:` line, approved PRs that have not merged and why, issues assigned to the owner with their age, `needs-input` issues oldest first), **Threads** (one line per ranked epic, working group and unthreaded PR: state, last moved, next step, who) and **Running fine** (counts only). If it is not on the desk, it does not need the owner; #31 and #33 are history. **Rules for every routine.** - **Thin prompt.** The trigger only points at its brief in `routines/`. Rules live in the brief, so a change is a pull request. - **Record first.** Each routine has a standing-job record in srs-programme (`routine_id`, `brief_path`) and an agent record with its `SRS_ACTOR`. `clerk routines --check` reports drift between records, triggers and briefs. - **Never run a brief that is not on the clerk default branch.** - **Stop honestly.** A run that hits a human gate comments the exact question, adds `needs-input`, and stops. - **Report what you learned.** Every report ends with a short "What we learned": which part of the theory held, which did not. Lifecycle and drift check: [routines.md](routines.md). Every routine and workflow: [tools.md](tools.md).
